title: The shared push-skip action only works on repos whose suite job names match exactly; a repo that adopts it learns the working form where it is written
why: Lane child-ci-q-max measured (coordinator 22:23 and 22:41 CST, relayed; the coordinator calls it checked on real runs): the shared action's suite list is every job key whose job-level `if` is true minus scope, all-jobs-passed, ci-done, push-skip, nightly-skip and the rollup's needs, matched by exact check-run name. On GitHub Actions a matrix job with a constant `name:` keeps its suffix (run 43557726741: `test (1)` to `test (3)`), so it never matches. A `name:` that references `matrix` gets no suffix, and every leg is named exactly the name (run 43557746396, form `name: test${{ matrix.shard == 0 && 'x' || '' }}`). An expression in a step name is evaluated in the jobs API (run 43557764774). The coordinator's earlier premise that a constant name works was wrong. SAMPLE 06:18 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 06:17; runner 11 read, and the coordinator REST read of the job list at 06:16): degen #706 first ready run 43593247313 (head ae4a503c1) names its jobs bare, `server` x2 and `app` x6, no `(1)` suffix. This holds the premise "child repos on @stable name their app and server jobs the bare way" for one run, n=1. The run had no conclusion at the read (queued); #706 is not merged. Treat the premise as read once, not proven. SIGHTING 08:58 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 08:57, from runner 11; unread by triage): degen #710's PR run (43605958575, green at head 6c63d5028) named its legs `server (1)` and `server (2)`, the old naming, because GitHub's merge ref for that run was older than main's #706, so the run did not test the push-skip workflow; the merge tool read it as a clean merge with a green run standing. Main's push run for 25cfef0e2 will show what the push skip does after a PR run on the old workflow. This is the opposite of the n=1 on #706 (bare names): the premise "bare names" holds only for a run whose merge ref holds #706. Degen #710 merged 08:55 CST, merge commit 25cfef0e27ea. VERDICT 09:35 CST Nov 14 (runner 11, 09:17 CST; unread by triage): degen main push run 974 for 25cfef0e2 (the #710 merge) completed SUCCESS, but the push skip did NOT skip: push-skip's decide step ran, then all 6 app legs, 2 server legs and deploy-gates ran in full. So this run is no first test of the skip path: the #710 PR run was on the old workflow (merge ref older than #706), so it did not prove this tree. all-jobs-passed and ci-done both show "skipped" on this push; the reason is unread. Main run 979 (fa6c594) completed success after 11 min, which hints it did not skip either; its jobs unread. Who merged #667 (main at 5cfc6c8df) is still unread. The first real test of the push skip on degen is still to come.
source: Coordinator 22:23 CST Nov 13 (relayed), lane child-ci-q-max; ruling qmax-skips-push-suite; decision uniform-over-variants.
note: Triage 22:40 CST Nov 13 (rewritten in place): a step, since every repo that adopts the skip hits it. Ask: one ci-hygiene snippet (docs) so repos copy one form, and a line in the push-skip decision, with the measured facts above and q_max and degen's fan-in as worked cases. Optionally a lint that names a suite job whose name carries a matrix suffix or a call prefix. Not started; do after the two child lanes report, so the text carries what they found. No change to the action itself (ruling: a repo changes to fit the tool). Needs a past-ruling and guard-record read before any build.
